tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search live paid x402 endpoints settled by OMNIGATE or 402Proof, filtered by text, network and max price.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get full details for one marketplace listing by id, including example input and output.

tools.name: start_purchase
tools.description: Request a listing unpaid and return its live x402 payment challenge plus the exact steps to pay through OMNIGATE or 402Proof. Nothing is charged.

tools.name: list_endpoint
tools.description: List your own x402 endpoint in the market for free. It is called unpaid and listed only if it returns a valid x402 v2 challenge on an OMNIGATE or 402Proof network.

tools.name: plan_mission
tools.description: Suggest up to three live catalog services for a task on one payment rail, within a spending ceiling. No payment or task execution occurs; review endpoint inputs and fee legs.

tools.name: get_recipes
tools.description: Get reusable catalog-matched task templates with current listing IDs on a single rail. Templates are not verified completed workflows; budget is expressed in atomic units.

tools.name: check_services
tools.description: Probe up to three catalog endpoints unpaid and rank valid live payment challenges by observed response time. Does not measure historical uptime, paid success or outcome quality.

tools.name: prepare_mission_step
tools.description: Recheck an approved listing's current x402 challenge against expected payout, rail, price and remaining atomic budget. Caller must inspect fees and sign; this tool never pays.

tools.name: check_watchlist
tools.description: Compare caller-held snapshots with the live public catalog for price, payment-term and catalog-presence changes. Callers retain snapshots and schedule polling; no push delivery.

tools.name: submit_mission_payment
tools.description: Submit an explicitly signed XRP payment through the verified seller's 402Proof key, record confirmed settlement once, and accrue separate 10% platform and $0.0100 facilitator fees. Never signs or holds funds; does not execute seller task inputs.
